name: Damon Technology Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Damon Technology Group Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, manufacture, sale, and service of intelligent logistics systems, key equipment, and core components in China and internationally. The company offers carton, pallet, vertical, overhead, belt, and pulley conveyor series; and flash, cross belt, sliding shoe, swivel wheel, multi-belt, split tray, and swing arm sorters, as well as electrical roller transfer and skewed wheel diverter machines.
